tanglish_ref: Enakku konjam seconds-ku munnadi OTP vandhuduchu, aana latest code-a correct driver-kitta dhaan share panren-nu confirm pannikanum.

text: Please tell the driver to slow down because I have not finished putting my luggage inside the vehicle.
tanglish_ref: En luggage-a vehicle-kulla innum complete-ah veikkala, so driver-a konjam slow-ah drive panna sollunga.

text: I am currently standing on the opposite side of the road, and I will cross over as soon as the traffic becomes lighter.
tanglish_ref: Naan ippo road-oda opposite side-la nikkiren, traffic konjam koranjadhum naan cross panni vandhuruven.

text: The driver said he would reach in ten minutes, but the application now shows an estimated arrival time of eighteen minutes.
tanglish_ref: Driver ten minutes-la reach aagiduven-nu sonnaaru, aana ippo application-la eighteen minutes ETA kaamikudhu.

text: I need to reach the railway station before my train departs, so please avoid roads with heavy traffic if there is another route available.
tanglish_ref: En train kelamburadhukku munnadi railway station-ku reach aaganum, so vera route irundha heavy traffic irukkura roads-a avoid pannunga.

text: The pickup location has changed because the original entrance is temporarily closed for construction.
tanglish_ref: Construction work nala original entrance temporary-ah close pannitaanga, so pickup location change aagiduchu.

text: Please ask the driver whether he can wait for five minutes while I finish my meeting and come downstairs.
tanglish_ref: Naan meeting-a mudichittu keezha vara five minutes aagum, adhukku varaikkum wait panna mudiyuma-nu driver kitta kelunga.

text: I cannot hear the driver clearly because there is too much background noise around me.
tanglish_ref: Enna suthi romba background noise irukku, so driver enna clear-ah kekka mudiyala.

text: The driver is calling me, but I am currently unable to answer the phone because I am inside a meeting.
tanglish_ref: Driver enakku call pannitu irukkaaru, aana naan ippo meeting-kulla irukken, so phone attend panna mudiyala.

text: Please tell the driver that I am standing next to the red signboard directly opposite the pharmacy.
tanglish_ref: Pharmacy-ku exact opposite-la irukkura red signboard pakkathula naan nikkiren-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

text: I have already shared my live location, but the driver says that the map is showing a different entrance.
tanglish_ref: Naan already live location share panniten, aana map-la vera entrance kaamikudhu-nu driver solraaru.

text: The vehicle number is TN 38 AB 7294, so please confirm that this is the correct vehicle before I get inside.
tanglish_ref: Vehicle number TN 38 AB 7294, so naan vehicle-kulla yeruradhukku munnadi idhu correct vehicle dhaana-nu confirm pannunga.

text: If the driver reaches before me, please ask him to wait near the security cabin instead of leaving the pickup location.
tanglish_ref: Driver enakku munnadi vandhuttaaru-na, pickup location-a vittu pogama security cabin pakkathula wait panna sollunga.

text: I have three bags with me, including one fragile suitcase, so please make sure there is enough space in the trunk.
tanglish_ref: En kitta moonu bags irukku, adhula oru fragile suitcase-um irukku, so trunk-la pothumaana space irukka-nu check pannunga.

text: The road ahead is blocked because of an accident, so the driver may need to take a longer route to reach the destination.
tanglish_ref: Accident nala munnadi road block aagirukku, so destination-ku reach aaga driver konjam long route edukkanum pola irukku.

text: I accidentally left my phone charger in the vehicle, so please contact the driver and ask whether he found it.
tanglish_ref: Thappudhala en phone charger-a vehicle-kulla vittuten, so driver-a contact panni avarukku adhu kidaichudha-nu kelunga.

text: The driver dropped me at the wrong entrance, and I need directions to reach the actual destination from here.
tanglish_ref: Driver enna wrong entrance-la drop pannitaanga, inga irundhu actual destination-ku eppadi poganum-nu directions venum.

text: I am not familiar with this area, so please explain to the driver exactly where I need to be picked up.
tanglish_ref: Enakku indha area pathi familiar illa, so enna exact-ah enga pickup panna vendum-nu driver-kitta explain pannunga.

text: The map says that the destination is only two kilometers away, but the current traffic could make the journey take more than fifteen minutes.
tanglish_ref: Map-la destination rendu kilometers dhaan distance-nu kaamikudhu, aana current traffic nala journey fifteen minutes-ku mela aagalam.

text: Please ask the driver to confirm the final fare before we start the trip because the amount shown on my application has changed.
tanglish_ref: Trip start panradhukku munnadi final fare-a confirm panna driver-kitta sollunga, yenna application-la kaamikura amount change aagiduchu.

text: I can see the vehicle approaching from the left, but I am not sure whether it is the taxi assigned to my booking.
tanglish_ref: Left side-la oru vehicle varradhu enakku theriyudhu, aana adhu en booking-ku assigned aana taxi dhaana-nu sure-ah theriyala.

text: The driver has arrived at the pickup point, but he is waiting on the other side of the building.
tanglish_ref: Driver pickup point-ku vandhutaanga, aana building-oda opposite side-la wait pannitu irukkaaru.

text: Please tell the driver that I will be wearing a grey jacket and carrying a red suitcase.
tanglish_ref: Naan grey jacket pottuttu red suitcase eduthuttu iruppen-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

text: Please tell the driver that I am waiting near the blue entrance.
tanglish_ref: Naan blue entrance pakkathula wait pannitu irukken-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

text: The driver is waiting at the wrong gate, so please redirect him to the main entrance.
tanglish_ref: Driver wrong gate-la wait pannitu irukkaaru, so avara main entrance-ku vara sollunga.

text: I am already inside the vehicle, and we are ready to start the trip.
tanglish_ref: Naan already vehicle-kulla irukken, trip start panna ready-ah irukkom.

text: Please ask the driver to stop near the next signal.
tanglish_ref: Adutha signal pakkathula vehicle-a stop panna driver-kitta sollunga.

text: The driver is moving in the opposite direction from my destination.
tanglish_ref: Driver en destination-ku opposite direction-la poittu irukkaaru.

text: I think the map has not updated my new pickup location yet.
tanglish_ref: En new pickup location-a map innum update pannala-nu ninaikkiren.

text: Please wait for me near the entrance while I finish my phone call.
tanglish_ref: Naan phone call-a mudikkura varaikkum entrance pakkathula enakkaga wait pannunga.

text: The security guard is asking for the vehicle details before allowing the driver inside.
tanglish_ref: Driver-a ulla viduradhukku munnadi security guard vehicle details kekkaraaru.

text: I have reached the location, but the driver has not arrived yet.
tanglish_ref: Naan location-ku vandhuten, aana driver innum varala.

text: The driver said he is five minutes away, but the map shows ten minutes.
tanglish_ref: Driver five minutes distance-la irukken-nu sonnaaru, aana map-la ten minutes kaamikudhu.

text: Please tell the driver that I am standing next to the ATM.
tanglish_ref: Naan ATM pakkathula nikkiren-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

text: I cannot cross the road because there is too much traffic right now.
tanglish_ref: Ippo romba traffic irukkuradhunaala ennaala road cross panna mudiyala.

text: Please ask the driver to wait until the traffic signal turns green.
tanglish_ref: Traffic signal green aagura varaikkum wait panna driver-kitta sollunga.

text: The vehicle is parked behind the building near the loading area.
tanglish_ref: Vehicle building-oda pinnadi loading area pakkathula park pannirukku.

text: I am carrying a large suitcase, so I need some help putting it in the trunk.
tanglish_ref: En kitta periya suitcase irukku, so adha trunk-la vekka konjam help venum.

text: Please confirm whether the driver has the correct booking details.
tanglish_ref: Driver kitta correct booking details irukka-nu confirm pannunga.

text: I received a notification saying that the ride has started, but I am still waiting outside.
tanglish_ref: Ride start aagiduchu-nu notification vandhudhu, aana naan innum veliya wait pannitu irukken.

text: The driver accidentally cancelled the ride while I was getting into the vehicle.
tanglish_ref: Naan vehicle-kulla yerumbodhu driver thappudhala ride cancel pannitaanga.

text: Please ask the driver if he can take the highway instead of the local road.
tanglish_ref: Local road-ku badhila highway-la poga mudiyuma-nu driver-kitta kelunga.

text: I would prefer to take a slightly longer route if it has less traffic.
tanglish_ref: Traffic kammiya irundha konjam long route-a irundhaalum parava illa, adha eduthukkalaam.

text: The driver is approaching the pickup point from the other side of the bridge.
tanglish_ref: Driver bridge-oda opposite side-la irundhu pickup point-ku vandhuttu irukkaaru.

text: Please tell the driver not to park directly in front of the entrance.
tanglish_ref: Entrance-ku direct-ah munnadi park panna vendam-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

text: I am standing near a large white signboard with the building name on it.
tanglish_ref: Building name irukkura periya white signboard pakkathula naan nikkiren.

text: The driver cannot hear me because there is too much traffic noise.
tanglish_ref: Romba traffic noise irukkuradhunaala driver ennaala pesuradha kekka mudiyala.

text: Please repeat the destination because I want to make sure it is correct.
tanglish_ref: Destination-a marubadiyum sollunga, adhu correct dhaana-nu naan confirm pannanum.

text: I have changed my destination, so please update the new location before we leave.
tanglish_ref: Naan destination change panniten, so naanga kelamburadhukku munnadi new location-a update pannunga.

text: The driver is asking me which entrance he should use.
tanglish_ref: Endha entrance use pannanum-nu driver enna kekkaraaru.

text: Please tell him to enter through the gate next to the petrol station.
tanglish_ref: Petrol station pakkathula irukkura gate vazhiya ulla vara sollunga.

text: I am waiting near the reception desk on the ground floor.
tanglish_ref: Naan ground floor-la reception desk pakkathula wait pannitu irukken.

text: The driver has reached the destination, but I need help finding the correct building.
tanglish_ref: Driver destination-ku vandhutaanga, aana correct building-a kandupidikka enakku help venum.

text: Please ask the driver to call me when he reaches the pickup location.
tanglish_ref: Driver pickup location-ku vandhadhum enakku call panna sollunga.

text: I accidentally left my wallet in the back seat of the vehicle.
tanglish_ref: Thappudhala en wallet-a vehicle-oda back seat-la vittuten.

text: Please contact the driver and ask him to check the back seat.
tanglish_ref: Driver-a contact panni back seat-a check panna sollunga.

text: The vehicle is moving very slowly because the road is crowded.
tanglish_ref: Road-la romba crowd irukkuradhunaala vehicle romba slow-ah poittu irukku.

text: I need to reach the airport as quickly as possible.
tanglish_ref: Enakku mudinja alavukku seekiram airport-ku reach aaganum.

text: Please tell the driver that I have a flight in two hours.
tanglish_ref: Innum rendu hours-la enakku flight irukku-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

text: There is a road closure ahead, so we need to take a different route.
tanglish_ref: Munnadi road close pannirukkaanga, so naanga vera route-la poga vendiyadhu irukku.

text: I am not sure whether this is the correct vehicle, so please verify the vehicle number.
tanglish_ref: Idhu correct vehicle dhaana-nu enakku sure-ah theriyala, so vehicle number-a verify pannunga.

text: Please tell the driver that I will meet him near the entrance in two minutes.
tanglish_ref: Rendu minutes-la entrance pakkathula driver-a meet panren-nu sollunga.

text: If the driver cannot find me, please ask him to call me instead of cancelling the ride.
tanglish_ref: Driver enna kandupidikka mudiyalena, ride cancel pannama enakku call panna sollunga.

text: Please tell the driver that I am waiting near the lift on the ground floor.
tanglish_ref: Naan ground floor-la lift pakkathula wait pannitu irukken-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

text: The driver has reached the location, but he is standing near a different building.
tanglish_ref: Driver location-ku vandhutaanga, aana vera building pakkathula nikkiraanga.

text: I am coming out of the building now, so please ask the driver to wait for a minute.
tanglish_ref: Naan ippo building-la irundhu veliya varren, so driver-a oru minute wait panna sollunga.

text: Please tell the driver to stop near the yellow board on the left side.
tanglish_ref: Left side-la irukkura yellow board pakkathula stop panna driver-kitta sollunga.

text: The driver is waiting near the wrong entrance, and I am walking toward him now.
tanglish_ref: Driver wrong entrance pakkathula wait pannitu irukkaaru, naan ippo avara nokki nadandhu varen.

text: I can hear the driver, but I cannot see him because there are too many people around me.
tanglish_ref: Driver pesuradhu kekkudhu, aana enna suthi romba per irukkuradhunaala avara paakka mudiyala.

text: Please ask the driver to stay where he is until I reach the vehicle.
tanglish_ref: Naan vehicle-kitta varaikkum driver irukkura edathulaaye wait panna sollunga.

text: The map shows that the driver is nearby, but I cannot find the vehicle.
tanglish_ref: Map-la driver pakkathula irukkaaru-nu kaamikudhu, aana vehicle-a kandupidikka mudiyala.

text: I think the driver has entered the wrong street.
tanglish_ref: Driver thappana street-kulla poittaaru-nu ninaikkiren.

text: Please ask the driver to come back to the previous signal.
tanglish_ref: Previous signal-kku thirumbi vara driver-kitta sollunga.

text: I am standing beside a red car near the main gate.
tanglish_ref: Main gate pakkathula red car-oda pakkathula naan nikkiren.

text: Please tell the driver that I am wearing a black jacket and carrying a blue bag.
tanglish_ref: Naan black jacket pottuttu blue bag eduthuttu irukken-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

text: The driver has called me twice, but I could not answer the phone.
tanglish_ref: Driver rendu thadava enakku call pannaaru, aana ennaala phone attend panna mudiyala.

text: I will call the driver back once I finish speaking to the security guard.
tanglish_ref: Security guard-kitta pesi mudichadhum driver-ku thirumbi call panren.

text: Please ask the driver whether he can wait for another ten minutes.
tanglish_ref: Innum ten minutes wait panna mudiyuma-nu driver-kitta kelunga.

text: The driver says he has arrived, but I am still five minutes away.
tanglish_ref: Driver vandhutaaraam, aana naan innum five minutes distance-la irukken.

text: I am almost at the pickup point, so please ask the driver not to leave.
tanglish_ref: Naan pickup point-kku almost vandhuten, so driver-a poga vendam-nu sollunga.

text: The pickup location is crowded, so it may take me a few minutes to find the vehicle.
tanglish_ref: Pickup location-la romba crowd irukku, so vehicle-a kandupidikka enakku konjam time aagalam.

text: Please tell the driver to wait beside the pharmacy instead of the supermarket.
tanglish_ref: Supermarket pakkathula wait pannama pharmacy pakkathula wait panna driver-kitta sollunga.

text: I am standing exactly where the map shows the pickup location.
tanglish_ref: Map-la pickup location kaamikura exact edathula dhaan naan nikkiren.

text: The driver is moving in the wrong direction again.
tanglish_ref: Driver marubadiyum thappana direction-la poittu irukkaaru.

text: Please check the navigation and make sure we are going toward the correct destination.
tanglish_ref: Navigation-a check panni naanga correct destination direction-la dhaan poromaa-nu confirm pannunga.

text: The road is completely blocked, so we will have to take a different route.
tanglish_ref: Road full-ah block aagirukku, so naanga vera route-la dhaan poga vendiyadhu irukku.

text: Please ask the driver to avoid the road near the market because it is usually very crowded.
tanglish_ref: Market pakkathula irukkura road-a avoid panna driver-kitta sollunga, anga usually romba crowd-ah irukkum.

text: I am in a hurry because I have an appointment in thirty minutes.
tanglish_ref: Enakku thirty minutes-la appointment irukku, so naan konjam avasaram-ah irukken.

text: Please take the fastest route even if the distance is slightly longer.
tanglish_ref: Distance konjam adhigama irundhaalum parava illa, fastest route-la ponga.

text: The estimated fare has increased since I started the ride.
tanglish_ref: Ride start pannadhula irundhu estimated fare increase aagiduchu.

text: Please explain why the fare is different from the amount shown when I booked the ride.
tanglish_ref: Naan ride book pannumbodhu kaamicha amount-um ippo irukkura fare-um yen different-ah irukku-nu explain pannunga.

text: I think I left my sunglasses somewhere inside the vehicle.
tanglish_ref: En sunglasses-a vehicle-kulla engaavadhu vittuten-nu ninaikkiren.

text: Please ask the driver to check underneath the passenger seat.
tanglish_ref: Passenger seat-keezha check panna driver-kitta sollunga.

text: I have already paid for the ride through the application.
tanglish_ref: Naan already application moolama ride-ku payment panniten.

text: Please confirm whether the payment has been received successfully.
tanglish_ref: Payment successful-ah receive aachaa-nu confirm pannunga.

text: The application is showing an error when I try to make the payment.
tanglish_ref: Payment panna try pannumbodhu application-la error kaamikudhu.

text: Please wait while I try the payment again.
tanglish_ref: Naan payment-a marubadiyum try panra varaikkum wait pannunga.

text: The driver has reached the destination, but I need help finding the exact entrance.
tanglish_ref: Driver destination-ku vandhutaanga, aana exact entrance-a kandupidikka enakku help venum.

text: Please tell the driver that I need to get down near the main entrance.
tanglish_ref: Enna main entrance pakkathula drop panna vendum-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

text: I have an elderly passenger with me, so please stop somewhere that is easy to access.
tanglish_ref: En kooda oru elderly passenger irukkaaru, so easy-ah access panna mudiyura edathula stop pannunga.

text: Please drive carefully because the road is wet and slippery.
tanglish_ref: Road wet-ahum slippery-ahum irukku, so careful-ah drive pannunga.

text: I am not comfortable taking this route because it is unfamiliar to me.
tanglish_ref: Indha route enakku familiar illa, so indha vazhiya poga enakku comfortable-ah illa.

text: Please let me know when we are approximately five minutes away from the destination.
tanglish_ref: Destination-ku approximately five minutes distance-la varumbodhu enakku sollunga.
